summary: A mixed day with significant retail sector movements and major Reliance Group developments. Legal cooperation agreements are expanding India's international presence while regulatory approvals advance major IPO plans.

bullets.text: SEBI approves Jio Platforms' $3.8 billion IPO, potentially India's biggest listing to date.
Pernod Ricard kicks off legal process for potential India IPO, evaluating all options for Indian operations.
Croma narrows losses significantly on turnaround path; quality of growth improves materially for Infiniti Retail.
SCCA and GCAI sign MOU to strengthen legal cooperation between India and Singapore frameworks.
Swiggy's Food on Train network expands to 201 railway stations across India.
